'''Emmoridg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Light Sith|Light]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as an [[Overseer (Sith)|overseer]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the Galactic [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He secretly trained acolytes in the light side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="lord" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Emmoridg was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Although not mentioned by name, choosing [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] options for Jaesa Willsaam has her hunting down light-sided Sith instead of helping them.<ref name="witch">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Jaesa Willsaam]]|Witch Hunt}}</ref>

{{GameLSmechanics}}
The apprentice of another light-leaning [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Lord]], [[Jaesa Willsaam]], discovered Emmoridg and contacted him. Emmoridg expressed concern that he would be discovered, and asked Jaesa and her master for protection for his students.<ref name="lord" />

Many of his students were later hunted and tortured by Lord [[Cendence]], a Sith Lord tasked with hunting down light-sided Sith, however Lord Cendence was stopped by Jaesa, ensuring the temporary safety of Emmoridg and his students.<ref name="cult">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Jaesa Willsaam|The Dark Cult}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}
